subject: science
title: Grade 3 Science — Set 2
description: Animals, plants, weather, and our body

questions.question: Which part of the plant grows underground?
questions.explanation: Roots grow underground. They absorb water and minerals and anchor the plant.

questions.question: What do caterpillars grow into?
questions.explanation: Caterpillars go through metamorphosis and become butterflies (or moths).

questions.question: Which season comes after Summer?
questions.explanation: The order is: Spring → Summer → Autumn → Winter.

questions.question: Which sense organ do we use for seeing?
questions.explanation: Eyes detect light and send signals to the brain so we can see.

questions.question: Which animal gives us milk?
questions.explanation: Cows are the most common source of milk. Buffalo and goats also give milk.
